chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Juʿfī narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever hires himself out has restricted sustenance upon himself. And how could he not restrict sustenance upon himself, when whatever he gains belongs to a master who hired him?

key_terms.آجَرَ: hired out or leased in service

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام describe the effect of hiring oneself out on one’s sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that making oneself fully subject to another in hired service constrains one’s access to rizq. It highlights economic dependence and the limitation that what one acquires in such a state is tied to the one who employs him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3657 - Abdullah bin Muhammad Al-Ju'fi narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
'Whoever hires himself out has restricted his sustenance. And how could he not restrict his sustenance when whatever he earns belongs to the master who hired him?'
